name: toolkit
description: Reusable, configurable development actions for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Discover useful built-in actions and run the exact variant you select through Codex. Perform binds required variables from your request and layers system, user, and repository action definitions with defined precedence. A separately installed codex-perform companion can launch the same actions from a shell.
capabilities: Discover reusable actions from the effective catalogue
Select and run exact action variants
Bind required action variables from the request
Layer system, user, and repository action definitions
